remarks: Welcome to 6 Silvermine Ave! This updated condo is conveniently located in the highly desirable Silvermine neighborhood. Step inside to find a well-designed interior that blends functionality with style. Off the living room, you walk out to a covered patio and lawn. This corner unit on the ground floor features hardwood throughout, creating a seamless and elegant look. The living area boasts ample natural light, creating a warm and welcoming atmosphere. The open layout flows seamlessly into the dining area and kitchen, perfect for entertaining or enjoying quiet meals at home. The kitchen has modern appliances, generous counter space, and plenty of storage. The bedroom features stylish paneling, adding a touch of elegance and charm, and offers a peaceful retreat with ample closet space and natural light. A brand-new HVAC system ensures year-round comfort, while the updated electric system adds modern efficiency and reliability. There is even additional private storage. Centrally located in Norwalk, this inviting condo offers easy access to all the highways, Metro North, shopping, restaurants, and the shoreline, making it ideal for those who love convenience and outdoor activities.
